note: Village of Gratiot campground off WI-11 beside the Cheese Country Recreation Trail in Lafayette County. Wolf Creek, a trout stream, runs past the sites into the Pecatonica River, and a footbridge crosses to the village park. The nearest dump station is a quarter mile away. ATV riders use it as a trail stop. --Claude
summary: Village page read: $20 electric / $15 non-electric, 24 W/E + 10 non-electric sites, showers, Wi-Fi, dump 1/4 mi off site, FCFS envelope, 14-day limit without approval, open for 2026. Creekside kept (Wolf Creek ~7 m wide, sites on open grass ~10-20 m from it). Lafayette County page refused.
flags: WATERFRONT: creekside kept. Wolf Creek is ~7 m wide on Esri imagery and runs along the east side of the camping loop; the pads on the loop's east edge around 42.5812,-90.0245 (just west of the stored pin) sit ~10-20 m from the bank over open mown grass. All sites are sold by the night (FCFS). Site numbers are not published.

OHV (reviewer, flag only): the village markets the campground to 'ATV enthusiasts' ('Fuel for ATV's just one block away'; 'Keep ATVs off the grass') - it sits beside the Cheese Country Recreation Trail, a multi-use ATV trail. It is a general village campground (34 sites, showers, playgrounds, trout stream), so an OHV side rather than a staging camp. Keep.
